mechanism: shape-derived standalone credential classification: markers are fixed points, signature-bearing values are blocked, opaque handles become a deterministic [SESS:sha12] surrogate applied identically to headers, pg parameters and replay keys

findings.description: opaque session handle never persists raw
the same credential yields ONE stable surrogate everywhere it appears
cookie header and pg parameter carry the identical surrogate
irrelevant cookie value is preserved, not mangled
surrogated artifact still replays the exact failure offline
signed cookie is privacy-blocked and never persists raw
JWT-shaped token is privacy-blocked and never persists raw
an unselected request's session credential never reaches a selected incident (raw)
not even the SURROGATE of an unselected credential reaches a selected incident
